headline: Profits surge year-over-year while sequential growth cools
summary_short: Revenue rose to $2,503.4M (+13.4% y/y, +4.3% q/q) while diluted EPS of $1.31 climbed +61.7% y/y but slipped -0.8% q/q; net income was $322.3M, +57.7% y/y and -2.3% q/q.
summary_long: Revenue of $2,503.4M was +13.4% y/y and +4.3% q/q. Net margin of ~12.9% expanded ~360bp y/y but eased ~90bp q/q as net income of $322.3M rose +57.7% y/y, -2.3% q/q. Diluted EPS of $1.31 was +61.7% y/y, -0.8% q/q. Pretax income $410.2M was +57.7% y/y, -0.8% q/q. Cash of $417.7M more than doubled both q/q (+106.7%) and y/y (+134.5%).
